title: Xenoverse Project
description: A mod that combines multiple monsters across si-fi horror
body:
THIS MOD IS IN ALPHA

This mod is created by me, but not all of its assets are.

ChestBurster and Ovamorph are created by me \
Facehuggers are created by LPaley \
And the Aliens are created by RedVoid_ \
Free Models Here-https://sketchfab.com/RedVoid_

Currently this mod only adds alien things, but there are plans to add more sci-fi monsters, such as demogorgons and godzilla.

If you know how to Model, Texture, or Animate, hit me up, I'd love to have some help.

Dependency-This mod is created using MCreator, and requires MCreator Link

Mcreator Link-https://mcreator.net/download/link

HOW MOD WORKS
- Find Crashsite and collect Broken Motion Detector
- Make a nether portal out of iron blocks and light it with the broken motion detector
- Find the aircraft on the moon and kill an egg
- Goodluck getting rid of them
